---
title: Examples of complete syntactic analyses
---


Four passages from `arsgrammatica`'s training set illustrate every category of syntactic relationship defined by `arsgrammatica`.




- [Vulgate *Genesis* 42.10](./examplepassages/gen42_10.qmd)
- [Vulgate *Genesis* 42.22](./examplepassages/gen42_22.qmd)
- [Cicero, *Pro Archia* 4](./examplepassages/proarch4.qmd)
- [Cicero, *Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd)




::: {.callout-tip}
Open the diagrams in a separate window or tab, or download them separately, if they are too small to read easily when included in these pages.
:::


## Find examples of a relationship category

The following table lists every relationship category alphabetically with a reference to one occurrence in the selected sentences.


| Relationship | Example (token → related token) | Sentence |
|---|---|---|
| ablative | *conventu* → *agatur* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| ablative absolute | *praetore* → *patiamini* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| accusative | *quod* → *perficiam* | [*Pro Archia* 4](./examplepassages/proarch4.qmd) |
| adjectival | *legitima* → *quaestione* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| adverbial | *in* → *uti* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| agent | *a* → *tribui* | [*Pro Archia* 4](./examplepassages/proarch4.qmd) |
| apposition | *virum* → *praetorem* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| aside | *spero* → *detis* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| attributive | *E* → *unus* | [*Genesis* 42.10](./examplepassages/gen42_22.qmd) |
| auxiliary | *est* → *tractata* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| circumstantial participle | *accommodatam* → *veniam* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| complementary infinitive | *esse* → *videatur* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| coordinating conjunction | *sed* → *quaeso* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| dative | *cui* → *videatur* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| direct object | *veniam* → *detis* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| direct quote | *est* → *dixerunt* | [*Genesis* 42.10](./examplepassages/gen42_10.qmd) |
| genitive | *vestrum* → *cui* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| indirect statement | *uti* → *videatur* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| object of preposition | *quaestione* → *in* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| praenomen | *A.* → *Licinium* | [*Pro Archia* 4](./examplepassages/proarch4.qmd) |
| predicate | *mirum* → *esse* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| relative pronoun | *quod* → *genere* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| subject | *me* → *uti* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| subordinating conjunction | *ne* → *quaeso* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| unit verb | *videatur* → *ne* | [*Pro Archia* 3](./examplepassages/proarch3.qmd) |
| vocative | *domine* → *est* | [*Genesis* 42.10](./examplepassages/gen42_10.qmd) |
